observations: A roughly rectangular head shape sits against layered dark-green shadow blobs; a white outline traces the outer edge while dense brown and blue scribble lines fill the interior.
Two eye sockets hold white oval highlights with black pupils; the left eye is larger and more open, the right smaller and partially shadowed, creating visible asymmetry.
A wide rectangular mouth near the lower third shows two rows of cream and white teeth outlined in red-orange, set against a black interior gap.
reading: The face pushes forward from its green ground, its lopsided eyes giving it an off-balance stare that reads as wary rather than aggressive. Brown scribble lines layer over the olive mass without fully covering it, leaving the surface feeling raw. The red-orange lip line is the only warm accent in an otherwise cool, dark field, pulling the eye down to the wide tooth-filled mouth.
